title: Anonymous Letters, Dated 28137, Addressed To Wayside And Central Police Stations Re Alleged Communist Suspects

page_data.en:
LCC
CEP
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch.
File No. D. 2778
37
REPORT
Date February 3, 1937.
Subject Anonymous letters, dated 28/1/37, addressed to Wayside and Central Police Stations re alleged communist suspects.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

With reference to the attached anonymous letters dated
28/1/37, addressed to Wayside and Central Police Stations
on the subject of six alleged communists, I have to report
that the principal individuals referred to in the letters
are Zung Loong Ts (曾龍志) and Zung Chuen Poh (曾全波),
particulars of whom are given hereunder:-
Zung Loong Ts: Age 23, native of Kwangtung, height 5'6",
medium build, dark red complexion, usually
dressed in foreign style clothing; a graduate
from the Shanghai Law University, Kiangwan.
He came to Shanghai 8 years ago and was until
recently employed as a teacher in the Toh Zai
(道材) Primary School, No.4, Lane 685, Seward
Road, and not the Jin Zung (金成) Primary
School, No.9-11 Lane 642, Seward Road, as
stated in the anonymous letter.
He together with his wife, Pan Ling (潘凌),
age 18, and family, resided in the rear room
on the ground floor of the Mau Shing Fruit Shop
(茂興), No.714 Seward Road (almost opposite
the Toh Zai Primary School) for a period of two
months and later removed to the Tsing Hwa (清化)
Primary School, No.287 Chaoufoong Road, about
a fortnight ago, where he is now employed as
a teacher. The address No.287 Chaoufoong Road
is that of a foreign style dwelling house which
is rented by the Tsing Hwa Primary School and
is not Zung's residence as alleged in the letter.
Zung Chuen Poh: Age 30, native of Taishan (台山), Kwangtung,

报告
日期：1937年2月3日。
事由：关于1937年1月28日寄给韦尔斯路巡捕房和中央巡捕房的匿名信，信中指控涉嫌共产主义者。
制作人：督察顾宝华（Kuh Pao Hwa） 转呈人：副督察长 J. Boyne

关于所附的1937年1月28日寄给韦尔斯路巡捕房和中央巡捕房的匿名信，信中提及六名涉嫌共产主义者，现报告如下：
信中提到的主要人物是曾龙志（Zung Loong Ts）和曾全波（Zung Chuen Poh），其具体情况如下：
曾龙志：23岁，广东籍，身高5英尺6英寸，中等身材，面色深红，通常穿着西式服装；毕业于江湾上海法政大学。他8年前来到上海，直到最近受雇于西华德路685弄4号的道材小学担任教师，而非如匿名信中所称的西华德路642弄9-11号的金成小学。
他与妻子潘凌（Pan Ling），18岁，及家人在西华德路714号茂兴水果店（几乎正对道材小学）底楼的后间居住了两个月，大约两周前搬至兆丰路287号的清化小学，目前在该校任教。兆丰路287号是一栋由清化小学租用的西式住宅，并非如信中所称是曾某的住所。
曾全波：30岁，广东台山籍，

height 5'7", slim build, dark complexion,
wearing foreign style clothing; ex-teacher of
the Zung Yuen (纵远) Middle School, Tai-shan
(台山), Kwangtung. His second visit to Shanghai
was in the Spring of 1936 and until the fall
term of that year he was employed as a teacher
in the Toh Zai Primary School, No.4, Lane 685
Seward Road; at that time he resided with his
wife Wu Pai Yen (伍佩颜) and family in the room
over the kitchen at the Kwan Ming Optical and
Dental Supply Shop, No.712 Seward Road. He is
now employed as a teacher at the Tsing Hwa
Primary School, No.287 Chaoufoong Road and has
taken up residence at the school.
From the foregoing it will be seen that both men were until
recently employed as teachers in the Toh Zai Primary School,
No.4, Lane 685 Seward Road, but, owing to frequent altercations
with the schoolmaster over the non-payment of their salaries, they
severed their connections with the school and have now entered
into the services of the Tsing Hwa Primary School, 287 Chaoufoong
Road. Some twenty pupils of the Toh Zai Primary School followed
them and joined the new school. This move has incurred the ill-
feeling of their previous employer.
The Tsing Hwa Primary School was established at the begin-
ning of 1937 by one Wu Wen Fu (伍文甫), age 28, native of
Kwangtung, a graduate of the Taishan College (台山中学), Kwangtung,
who recently arrived in this city. The opening ceremony took
place on February 2, 1937.

穿着西式服装；曾任广东台山纵远中学教师。
他第二次来上海是在1936年春季，直到那年秋季学期，他在西华德路685弄4号的道材小学担任教师；当时他与妻子伍佩颜（Wu Pai Yen）及家人住在西华德路712号光明眼镜牙科用品店厨房上方的房间里。他目前在兆丰路287号的清化小学担任教师，并已在校内居住。
综上所述，这两人直到最近都在西华德路685弄4号的道材小学任教，但由于因薪资未付问题与校长频繁发生争执，他们切断了与该校的联系，现已受雇于兆丰路287号的清化小学。道材小学约有二十名学生跟随他们转入新学校。这一举动招致了他们前雇主的不满。
清化小学由伍文甫（Wu Wen Fu）于1937年初创办，伍文甫28岁，广东籍，毕业于广东台山中学，近期抵达本市。开学典礼于1937年2月2日举行。

regarding the possible subversive activities of the foregoing
suspects as well as the remaining four individuals have so
far proved of no avail and there is no record with the Special
Branch of communist raids in connection with these schools nor
is there any record on file concerning the alleged suspects.
In summing up one may say that the general tone of the
letters, the date (prior to the opening of the Tsing Hwa School)
on which they were sent, the groundless allegation of a raid
on the Jin Zung Primary School as well as other wild allegations
and suggestions, all this tends to indicate that the writer is
moved by spite with a view to causing annoyance to rival schools.
The postal cancellation marks on the envelopes indicate
that the letters were posted at the C.P.O. Branch Office, No.456
Broadway East, at 9 a.m. and 10 a.m. January 28, 1937
respectively.
An examination of the handwriting contained in the attached
letters was made by Clerk May Yoh, handwriting expert, Headquarters who
certified that the letters were written by one and the same
person.
Kuh Tao-hwa
D. I.

关于上述嫌疑人及其他四人的可能颠覆活动，迄今尚无结果，特别股档案中也没有涉及这些学校的共产党搜查记录，也没有关于上述嫌疑人的存档记录。
总结而言，可以说信件的整体语气、发送日期（在清化学校开学之前）、对金成小学进行搜查的无端指控以及其他荒谬的指控和建议，都表明写信人是出于恶意，旨在给竞争对手学校制造麻烦。
信封上的邮戳显示，信件分别于1937年1月28日上午9点和10点投寄于百老汇路456号中央邮政局分局。
总部笔迹专家梅约（May Yoh）书记员对附件中信件的笔迹进行了检查，并证明这些信件是由同一人所写。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. File No. 33...
Wayside Station 2278
REPORT
Date Jan. 29 19 37

Subject Re attacked anonymous letters.

Made by D.S.I. Cumming. Forwarded by

Sir,
The following are translations of two anonymous letters
received at Wayside Station at 11.30 a.m. and 2.30 p.m.
respectively on 28.1.37:-
"Sir,
We beg to report that prior to the knowledge that Marshall
Cheng Hsueh Liang was collaborating with the communists and
planning a rebellion in Sian, communism in Shanghai had already
attained a lot of influence. When seven members (lawyers) of
the National Salvation Association were arrested by the Govern-
ment of this Municipality, we petitioned the officials request-
ing them to arrest the communists who obtained the signatures
of labourers and instigated them to create trouble as a protest
against the Central Government. No attention was paid to our
request. At present communist Zung Yong Tai, etc are busy
provoking ignorant male and female workers to create trouble in
the rear and thus assist their comrades in Sian. Members of the
local government are still unaware of this. We have heard that
the movements of these instigators are secret and thus it is
difficult for detectives to locate their rendezvous unless
they are experienced in dealing with communistic cases and know
the affairs of the interior. Most of the communists live in the
Settlement as a means of protection. They live in foreign
dwellings as if they were bona-fide residents. They also
establish schools for the purpose of disseminating propaganda
amongst the workers. In addition they have recruited a number
of youths whom they have formed into a "Red Army" and "Demonstra-
tion Group". They have also organised a party entitled the
"Sing Song Group" which sings the "Community Line".

韦尔斯路巡捕房 2278
报告
日期：1937年1月29日

事由：关于收到的匿名信。

制作人：副督察长 Cumming。转呈人

先生，
以下是1937年1月28日上午11:30和下午2:30分别在韦尔斯路巡捕房收到的两封匿名信的译文：
“先生，
我们要报告的是，在得知张学良将军与共产党合作并计划在西安叛乱之前，上海的共产主义已经获得了很大的影响力。当全国救国会的七名成员（律师）被本市政府逮捕时，我们曾向官员请愿，要求逮捕那些获得工人签名并煽动他们制造事端以抗议中央政府的共产党人。我们的请求未被理会。目前，共产党人曾永泰（Zung Yong Tai，音译）等人正忙于煽动无知的男女工人在后方制造事端，从而协助他们在西安的同志。地方政府成员对此仍不知情。我们听说这些煽动者的行踪秘密，因此侦探很难找到他们的聚集地，除非他们经验丰富，懂得处理共产党案件并了解内部事务。大多数共产党人住在租界以寻求保护。他们住在西式住宅里，仿佛是正当居民。他们还建立学校，目的是在工人中传播宣传。此外，他们还招募了一批青年，组成了‘红军’和‘示威团’。他们还组织了一个名为‘唱歌团’的团体，演唱《国际歌》。

Please make discreet enquiries in order to remove those
trouble-makers. The addresses of those communists will be given
in a further letter as soon as they can be ascertained.

Koh Ts Yong
Liang Veng Ding
Zsu Teh Su

Please excuse us for not giving names."

"Sir,
This is to report that one Zung Loong Ts was formerly a
communist in Kuangtung Province. He fled to Shanghai when an
anti-communist drive was inaugurated there by the authorities.
He concealed himself in the Foreign Settlement, Shanghai, where
he was once employed by the 'Jin Zung Primary School' as a
teacher in communistic literature. At the same time he was
engaged in secretly inciting workers in the Eastern District
along Cheufoong and East Seward Roads. He made good his escape
when teachers of the above mentioned school had been arrested.
His last address was a fruit shop at 714 Seward Road, from
where he removed to a foreign house at 287 Cheufoong Road. He
has a large quantity of communistic literature for dissemination.
Another communist named Zung Chuen Poh who recently removed
from Haining Road to a rear upstairs room of the Kwan Ming Co.
718 Seward Road, visits Zung Yoong Ts, 287 Cheoufoong Road,
corner of Tongshan Road where they hold secret meetings. This
man also possesses a number of communistic books. From the
information you may trace the place and find the communistic
literature. These communists are full of cunning tricks and they
have the power to incite others.

“先生，
兹报告，曾龙志（Zung Loong Ts）以前是广东省的一名共产党人。当当局在那里发起反共运动时，他逃到了上海。他藏身于上海公共租界，曾受雇于‘金成小学’担任教授共产主义文学的教师。同时，他秘密煽动兆丰路和东西华德路沿线的东区工人。在上述学校的教师被捕后，他成功逃脱。他最后的地址是西华德路714号的一家水果店，随后搬至兆丰路287号的一栋西式住宅。他拥有大量用于传播的共产主义文献。
另一名最近从海宁路搬至西华德路718号光明公司楼上后间的共产党人曾全波（Zung Chuen Poh），经常拜访位于通山路和兆丰路拐角处兆丰路287号的曾永泰（Zung Yoong Ts，音译），他们在那里举行秘密会议。此人也拥有一些共产主义书籍。根据这些信息，您可以追踪地点并找到共产主义文献。这些共产党人诡计多端，具有煽动他人的能力。

(3)                          Station,

Subject........................................................................

Made by....................................Forwarded by....................................

Before you raid the premises you have first to make certain
secret enquiries during the daytime. Female communist Wu Kong
Chiu is delegated by the party to secretly incite female workers
whilst Lee Vung Ts, Yang Kwan Yuen, Lee Kong, Wu Koo Li etc. are
employed in distributing literature of a communistic nature
and inciting workers to commit violent acts.

They are prepared to combine with labourers in Shanghai
to promote a general strike in Shanghai in the near future for
the purpose of causing disturbances.

Zung Yoong Ts will take the position of leader in charge
of the 3rd organisation of the Eastern District whilst Zung
Chun Poh will take the 5th organisation. Wu Kong Chiu will be
in charge of the womens section.

They are also planning to assassinate General Tsai Ching
Chuen.

Not signed."

Detectives have been detailed to keep the addresses
mentioned under observation and to make discreet enquiries in
the vicinity with a view to ascertaining whether there is any
truth in the information contained in these letters.

D.S.I.

O. i/c Special Branch.

page_data.en:
Translation of precis of anonymous letter addressed
to Central Police Station. October 1927

Undated.

Chen Yung Tsu, a communist-bandit, became a communist
when he was formerly in Canton and escaped to Shanghai when
the Kuomintang was purged. He continued his activities under
the pretence of being a schoolmaster and was nearly arrested
when the Chin Chen Elementary School was raided the year
before last. Recently he has been seen in the district of
Seward and Chaoufoong Roads where there are many factories.
Formerly he resided at No.714 Seward Road. Now he rented
House No.257 Chaoufoong Road and keeps a number of communistic
books. Chen Chun Pe, another communist, formerly resided
at Haining Road and has now removed into House No.714
(in a room over the cook house), Seward Road. He occasionally
visits House No.257, corner of Tongshan and Chaoufoong Roads
for the purpose of attending secret meetings. They would
never confess anything unless they are tortured when they
should be interrogated. Wu K'ang Ch'iu who incites female
workmen is a female bandit. Li Wan Che, Yang Kuan Yung,
Li Shao Kang and Ho K'u Lei etc. are engaged in activities
such as communication, propaganda and riot. With an intent
to create disturbances, Chen Yung Tsu is i/c of the 3rd
Section, Chen Chun Po i/c of the 5th Section, Wu K'ang
Ch'iu i/c of the Women's Section in the Eastern District
of Shanghai. They also plan to assassinate General Tsai
Chin Shan etc.

Not signed.
page_data.zh:
寄给中央巡捕房的匿名信摘要译文。1927年10月

无日期。

陈永祖（Chen Yung Tsu，音译），一名共产党匪徒，以前在广州时成为共产党人，在国民党清党时逃到上海。他伪装成校长继续活动，在前年金真小学（Chin Chen Elementary School，音译）被搜查时差点被捕。最近有人在西华德路和兆丰路一带看到他，那里有很多工厂。他以前住在西华德路714号。现在他租下了兆丰路257号的房子，并藏有大量共产主义书籍。陈春波（Chen Chun Pe，音译），另一名共产党人，以前住在海宁路，现在搬进了西华德路714号（厨房上方的一个房间）。他偶尔会去通山路和兆丰路拐角处的257号房子参加秘密会议。除非在审讯时受到酷刑，否则他们绝不会承认任何事情。煽动女工的吴康秋（Wu K'ang Ch'iu，音译）是一名女匪。李万哲（Li Wan Che，音译）、杨关永（Yang Kuan Yung，音译）、李少康（Li Shao Kang，音译）和何苦雷（Ho K'u Lei，音译）等人从事通讯、宣传和暴乱等活动。为了制造骚乱，陈永祖负责上海东区第三科，陈春波负责第五科，吴康秋负责妇女科。他们还计划刺杀蔡金山将军（General Tsai Chin Shan，音译）等人。

未署名。

page_data.en:
Translation of precis of anonymous letter B
addressed to Central Police Station. Yau-
Chow Road

Undated.

Further to our letters, we wish to inform
you that the communist-bandits reported therein
who reside at No.287 Chaoufoong Road, now run
a school entitled "Chin Hua Elementary School".
Under the name of running a school, they carry
on their communistic activities with a view to
creating disturbances. According to their regu-
lations of the school, the institution is not
run in accordance with the educational policy
of the Government. That they dared to sovietize
education etc. must be banned.

(Signed):        Chang Ting Yu

无日期。

继我方此前去函，现特告知，信中所述居住于兆丰路287号的共匪，目前开办了一所名为“金华小学”的学校。他们借办学之名，行共产主义活动之实，意图制造骚乱。根据该校规章，该机构的运作并不符合政府的教育政策。其胆敢推行教育苏维埃化等行为，必须予以禁止。

Translation of precis of anonymous letter
addressed to Central Police Station, Foo-
chow Road.

Undated.

Before the staging of the coup at Sian by
Chang Hsueh Liang, local communists were very
active. When the Shanghai City Government arrested
seven leaders of the National Salvation Association
communists incited workmen of the various factories
to harass the Government. Meantime Chen Yung Tzu,
a communist, is again inciting ignorant workmen
with a view to creating a disturbance. As soon as
his address is ascertained, a further communication
will be forwarded.

(Signed):        Kuo Tzu Yung
                Chang Wen Ting
                Shao T'a Shi
